cues.en: We predicted a straight line with PyTorch somewhere in here, and now we're deploying computer vision models to the internet for everyone to use.
cues.zh: 在這裡某處，我們用 PyTorch 預測一條直線，現在卻把電腦視覺模型部署到網路，讓所有人使用。

cues.en: So congratulations on making it to the end of Milestone Project three.
cues.zh: 恭喜完成里程碑專案三。

cues.en: But here are some main takeaways.
cues.zh: 不過，整理幾個重點。

cues.en: And the first one is deployment is as important as training.
cues.zh: 第一，部署和訓練一樣重要。

cues.en: So once you've got your first working model or a good working model, your first question after that should be how can I deploy this and make it accessible to others?
cues.zh: 有了第一個可運作、或表現良好的模型之後，下一個問題應該是：如何部署，讓其他人也能使用？

cues.en: So building on the back of PyTorch transfer learning, one of the main takeaways there was is there a pre-trained model for the problem I'm working on?
cues.zh: 延續 PyTorch 遷移學習，那裡一個主要重點是：目前問題有預訓練模型可用嗎？

cues.en: And hugging face is a great place to find pre-trained models.
cues.zh: Hugging Face 很適合找預訓練模型。

cues.en: The same thing with torch vision models or other PyTorch domain libraries.
cues.zh: torchvision.models 或其他 PyTorch 領域函式庫也一樣。

cues.en: So when you're working on a problem, ask the question is there a pre-trained model for my particular problem?
cues.zh: 所以，處理問題時，先問有沒有適合這個特定問題的預訓練模型。

cues.en: And then the next question after you've got a pretty good model, how can I deploy it and make it accessible to others?
cues.zh: 接著有了不錯的模型，再問如何部署，讓其他人能使用。

cues.en: The reason being is because deployment allows you to test your model in the real world rather than on private training and test sets.
cues.zh: 因為部署讓我們能在真實世界測試，而不是只用私有的訓練與測試集。

cues.en: Then of course, for machine learning model deployment.
cues.zh: 接著，模型部署方面，

cues.en: The three important questions, of course there's many more, but these are just three big questions.
cues.zh: 有三個重要問題。當然還有更多，但這三個很主要。

cues.en: What's the most ideal use case for the model?
cues.zh: 模型最理想的使用情境是什麼？

cues.en: How well and how fast does it perform?
cues.zh: 表現要多好，速度要多快？

cues.en: Once you've asked the or once you've thought of the most ideal use case, you can start there and work backwards.
cues.zh: 想好理想情境後，就能從那裡往回推。

cues.en: So for Food Vision, Big and Food Vision many, we found that, hey, we want this to work on a mobile device and we want it to be fast and we want the predictions to come back online.
cues.zh: 對 FoodVision Big 與 Mini，我們希望能在行動裝置使用、速度快，而且預測以線上方式回來。

cues.en: We want it to happen in real time.
cues.zh: 希望即時完成。

cues.en: But there's a few different options here, such as on device or also known as the Edge, the Cloud Bean, another computer that isn't the actual device that someone is using.
cues.zh: 不過，有幾個不同選項，例如裝置端，又稱邊緣端；或雲端，也就是使用者實際裝置以外的另一台電腦。

cues.en: And these can mix and match with online prediction real time and offline prediction batch.
cues.zh: 這些也能搭配線上即時預測，以及離線批次預測。

cues.en: So let's go back.
cues.zh: 回到這裡。

cues.en: Deployment options are aplenty.
cues.zh: 部署選項很多。

cues.zh: 我們看過 Hugging Face Spaces，是很適合入門的方式之一。

cues.zh: 機器學習維運是 DevOps 的延伸，DevOps 是開發與維運的實務，
